outcome: time taken to collect surgical materials
time taken from decision of category-1 emergency caesarean section arrival to the operation theater
time taken from arrival at the operation theater to the immediate start of skin incision
cohort: 163 clients who underwent category-1 emergency caesarean section between March and May 2018 at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital
finding: The average decision to delivery time interval for category-1 emergency caesarean sections was longer than the recommended 30 minutes but did not affect feto-maternal outcomes.
